desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on U.S. strike planning against Iran (including MOAB options) and fresh Western aid plus Ukrainian strikes in the Russia-Ukraine war. The single most important thread is U.S. contingency plans for large-scale strikes on Iranian energy and nuclear infrastructure.

## MAIN THREADS

### U.S. MOAB strike plans for Iran
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110768639787893239) reports U.S. officials confirming strike packages that include the GBU-43B MOAB against Iranian energy sites and nuclear facilities such as Pickaxe Mountain; plans are options only and no order has been given.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110768639787893239) notes White House and Pentagon statements that all options remain on the table while declining to comment on specific plans.

### UK Storm Shadow missiles for Ukraine
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110760324676866556) cites Bloomberg reporting a new UK package of Storm Shadow cruise missiles to be delivered in coming weeks for strikes on Russian assets targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

### Ukrainian strike on Russian drone training center
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110756037204578381) reports Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian drone training center and barracks in Kherson Oblast operated by the 18th Combined Arms Army over the weekend, linking to DIU footage.

### U.S. carrier operations in CENTCOM
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110739938232729643) notes USS George H.W. Bush (CVN-77) has returned to the Arabian Sea after a port visit to Phuket, marking the first such deployment stop.

### UKMTO maritime advisory
- [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2110743160376660070) released Update 105 JMIC Advisory Note on 15 October covering maritime security.

## CONTESTED
[@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110736578192584783) corrected a reposted claim of a new U.S. airbridge to the Middle East, identifying it as a poor rip of three-month-old flightradar24 data.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- U.S. plans explicitly include MOAB use against Iranian nuclear sites (unconfirmed) [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110768639787893239).
- Trump stated former Army Major Nadal Hasan’s execution by firing squad will not be live-streamed (unconfirmed) [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2110737911087775861).
- UK Storm Shadow package is specifically for hitting Russian energy-targeting assets (unconfirmed) [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2110760324676866556).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for any White House decision on resuming strikes in CENTCOM and for confirmation of the next UK missile deliveries to Ukraine. Naval movements in the Arabian Sea and any follow-on Ukrainian strikes on Russian rear-area targets remain on the radar.
